agora_harms: Violation of civil or human rights, including privacy

summary.short: Italian data protection authority (Garante) order of 30 January 2025 declaring unlawful the processing of personal data by Hangzhou DeepSeek and Beijing DeepSeek. It orders a definitive limitation of processing of data subjects located in Italy, effective immediately on receipt of the order.
summary.long: The Garante per la protezione dei dati personali adopted this decision on 30 January 2025 concerning the DeepSeek service, which two Chinese companies run through app, website and software. The recitals record that the companies stated they had not entered and did not plan to enter the Italian market and had removed the app from local app stores. The Garante found the app no longer available in Apple and Google app stores, the website still accessible with registration limited, and existing registered users still able to log in. It applies GDPR Article 3(2)(a) because the companies offer the service to data subjects in Italy. The findings cite unanswered information requests (Art. 31), an English-only privacy policy not fully meeting Arts. 12-14, unspecified lawful bases (Art. 6), deficiencies affecting the exercise of rights (Chapter III), storage in the People's Republic of China (Art. 32), and no designated representative (Art. 27). The operative part declares the processing unlawful, orders a definitive limitation of processing of data subjects in Italy under Art. 58(2)(f) GDPR with immediate effect on receipt, and reserves further determinations pending the investigation. It orders recording in the Garante's internal register. The decision recalls that non-compliance may trigger the criminal penalty in Art. 170 of the Code and administrative fines under Art. 83(5)(e) GDPR. Appeal lies to the ordinary court within thirty days of communication, or sixty days if the applicant resides abroad.

relations.note: The order is issued under Art. 58(2)(f) and the declaration under Art. 57(1)(a) and (i) of the Regulation, which is also the substantive norm applied (Arts 3(2)(a), 6, 12-14, 27, 31, 32 and Chapter III).

notes: Document header shows doc. web n. 10098477; registry metadata gives 10097450 (document is authoritative). Italian operative part names both companies as data controllers; the English dispositive names only Hangzhou in the declaration and uses singular 'Company' in one recital. The decision is dated 30 January 2025 but refers to a privacy policy 'aggiornata al 5 dicembre 2025', a later date; this is internally inconsistent and both are recorded as stated. The limitation is described as 'definitiva' yet made subject to a further decision after the investigation; no end date is given. The order is a limitation of processing, not a fine; penalties are referenced only for non-compliance.
